# What's working now — aggregate patterns

**The derived scorecard.** Regenerated by `/ps:post-pulse` after each run from the
records in `posts.jsonl`. The raw data is the source of truth; this file is the
cross-post math on top of it, in plain language, so `/ps:post` can draft *strategy*
(which register, which CTA, how long) without recomputing 50 records mid-draft.

This is not `examples.md`. `examples.md` teaches the **shape** of one good post;
this file teaches **what to write and where the skill's own rules disagree with the
data.** Read both before drafting.

> Regenerated 2026-10-06 (pulse window widened to 2026-08-27→2026-10-06, 40 days
> since the last pulse, plus a re-measure pass on 16 posts from June–August).
> 50 LinkedIn posts, 0 Twitter/X. **Data correction this pulse:** `posted_at` was
> off by 1–11 days on 12 records and 4 URLs pointed at the wrong post; both were fixed
> from the post IDs, which is why the day-of-week table moved. Cells with n<4 are
> directional only, never hard rules.

**Baseline:** median engagement rate **2.15%** (avg 2.23%), across 43 posts with
≥500 impressions. Field-average engagement (reactions+comments+reposts) is **65**.
Anything above ~2% ER / ~65 eng is pulling its weight.

## Pillar — which register to write in (STRONG signal)

| Pillar                | Avg eng | Avg comments | n  | vs field |
|-----------------------|--------:|-------------:|---:|----------|
| operators-journal     |   83.1  |        10.4  |  9 | +28% ▲   |
| educational-tactical  |   78.9  |        17.4  |  8 | +22% ▲   |
| industry-take         |   65.2  |         9.6  | 14 | ±0       |
| build-in-public       |   50.2  |         4.5  | 19 | −23% ▼   |

→ **RULE, still inverted (4th pulse running):** 2 of the 3 new posts were again
  build-in-public, now 19 of 50 posts and the weakest pillar by a quarter. It also pulls
  the fewest comments (4.5 avg vs 17.4 for educational-tactical). No new
  operators-journal or educational-tactical post since 2026-08-18. Weight the next
  posts toward those two.

## CTA — how to close (STRONG signal)

| CTA                 | Avg eng | n  |
|---------------------|--------:|---:|
| karma-waitlist      |  121.0  |  1 |
| dm-advisory         |   97.8  | 10 |
| github              |   73.8  |  5 |
| discord             |   57.0  |  2 |
| (none)              |   52.8  | 22 |
| engagement-question |   52.0  |  7 |
| newsletter          |   46.3  |  3 |

→ **RULE + CONTRADICTION (4 consecutive pulses: 07-11, 07-17, 08-27, 10-06):**
  "DM me" still beats an engagement-question close by ~1.9×. Engagement-question is
  tied with no CTA at all. This contradicts `/ps:post`'s "always end with a question"
  default. **Rewrite proposed again, still awaiting Pedro's approval.** All 3 new posts
  closed with no CTA. The first-customer post (37 eng) would have been a natural place
  for "If you run collections in the DR, DM me."

## Length (MODERATE signal)

| Bucket          | Avg eng | n  |
|-----------------|--------:|---:|
| 400–800 chars   |   67.1  | 23 |
| <400 chars      |   66.1  | 11 |
| 800+ chars      |   61.0  | 16 |

→ **RULE:** Mid and short posts are effectively tied, and long posts still trail. The
  3-sentence `detailed-records` caption (over a video) posted the best ER in the dataset
  (below). This still conflicts with the skill's "700–1,500 typical" default (4th pulse).

## Day of week (WEAK-to-MODERATE signal; reshuffled by the date fix)

| Day  | Avg eng | n  |
|------|--------:|---:|
| Thu  |   92.0  |  3 |
| Mon  |   78.1  |  7 |
| Sun  |   77.0  | 10 |
| Sat  |   77.0  |  3 |
| Wed  |   71.0  |  3 |
| Fri  |   53.9  | 16 |
| Tue  |   43.4  |  8 |

→ **WATCH:** with dates corrected, Sunday is the best-supported strong day (n=10).
  Friday (n=16, most-posted) and Tuesday (n=8) stay clearly below the field. Thu/Sat/Wed
  are n=3 and directional only. Avoid Tue/Fri for anything you want to land.

## Outliers worth studying

- **Highest ER with a real sample:** `ln-2026-09-29-detailed-records-collections`,
  **4.35%** (27 eng / 621 imp). A 3-sentence caption on a product video ("if it's not
  recorded, it didn't happen"). It is only 1 week old and has low reach, so treat it as a
  lead to watch, not a rule. Next: `ln-2026-05-29-vertical-voice-ai-niche` 3.8%, then
  `ln-2026-08-20-dozens-collections-execs-dr` 3.0% (operators-journal + DM close).
- **Best new post by volume:** `ln-2026-09-27-first-qcobro-customer`, 37 eng / 1,499 imp
  (2.5% ER). It's a milestone with a "can't say who yet" tease, so the reveal post is the
  natural follow-up.
- **Reach has plateaued:** every post since mid-July lands at **0.8k–1.7k impressions**.
  Nothing has cleared 3k since the Routr post on 2026-06-29 (3,959). No new exemplars
  this pulse.
- **Growth curves:** posts gain little after ~2 weeks. Re-measured mid-August posts added
  +2–29% impressions over 40 days (most under 15%). The one exception is the 08-27 post, which was
  captured 1 hour after posting last time (166 → 1,464). LinkedIn reach is mostly
  settled within ~10 days.

## Open questions for the next pulse (data gaps)

- **Cadence dropped:** only 3 posts in 40 days (vs 7 in the prior 41). There isn't
  enough fresh data to judge new hooks.
- **`top_comments`:** 7 records now carry comments in their latest snapshot, up from 3.
  Recurring commenters are a small, warm circle of DR and telecom contacts.
- **`ln-2026-10-05-dr-almost-nobody-voice-ai`** was 19h old at capture (301 imp).
  Re-measure next pulse.
- **No Twitter/X data.** All patterns above are LinkedIn-only.

---

### How this file is regenerated

`/ps:post-pulse` recomputes this after each sweep from `posts.jsonl`: averages by
pillar / CTA / length / day-of-week, the ER baseline, the current outliers, and any
place a data pattern contradicts a rule in `/ps:post` (surface those explicitly — they
are the highest-value output; if a contradiction holds across ≥2 pulses, propose the
rule edit for Pedro's approval). Keep it short (~1 screen); it is a summary, not an
archive. Treat every cell with n<4 as directional.
